svg.text: McCzarny recently made significant updates
across his repositories. In
chromium-daily-digest, he focused on improving
workflow reliability by adjusting cron
schedules and enhancing summary generation with
a limit of 25 important changes. He also added
comprehensive OpenCode support, including
defining fallback runs and integrating its Go
API, while also adding model information to
summaries. For opencode-sessions, he refined
how session statuses are displayed, ensuring
"NEEDS INPUT" is prioritized. A major overhaul
of its build process saw a migration from
Rollup to esbuild, enabling an upgrade to
TypeScript 7 and resolving dependency issues.
He also updated development dependencies and
improved the README with a screenshot and
clearer installation instructions. In dcvis, he
expanded the project by adding "Trzebnica" and
"Piaseczno" Data Centers. He also made various
wording fixes and adjusted map display settings
for better visibility.
